patterns.name: unsigned_new_service_persistence
conditions: description indicates a new or changed unsigned service
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1543 covers creating or modifying system processes, including services, to establish persistence.

patterns.name: suspicious_scheduled_task
conditions: description indicates an unfamiliar task and an unusual or temporary executable
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1053 covers scheduled task/job execution used to maintain persistence or execute at a chosen time.

patterns.name: startup_folder_persistence
conditions: description indicates a new or unfamiliar Startup-folder program
patterns.evidence: Startup-folder changes can make a program run automatically when a user signs in; this is a persistence signal, not proof by itself.

patterns.name: ambiguous_persistence_change
conditions: T1543 or T1053 is present and the event describes an unverified service, task, or startup change
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1543 and T1053 describe service/process and scheduled-task persistence techniques; incomplete evidence warrants alerting rather than blocking.
